## Checklist

- [ ] This PR does one thing (a feature, a fix, or a refactor — not a mix)
- [ ] CI is green (format, lint, typecheck, tests, build)
- [ ] New behavior has a test, or I explained above why not
- [ ] I ran the app and tried the change myself
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, or debug leftovers in the diff
